reference_limits.timing: Use the median of all twenty reference-b observations from the same A/A capture. Multiply maxima by 1.10; divide throughput minima by 1.10.
reference_limits.binary: Use six freshly built, stripped x64 PE products from the pinned reference. Multiply each byte count by 1.10 and round up.
reference_limits.allocation: Keep all thirteen existing absolute limits unchanged, including three exact-zero contracts. Run all forty-seven allocation workloads and both exact zero-test hosts.
reference_limits.seal: Seal reference-only limits before evaluating the candidate. Candidate measurements cannot define or change these limits. Both interleaved paired modes and both sets of thirty-three absolute gates must pass.

compiler_cleanup: In complete mode only, pinned Cargo build and test --no-run may use the same hash-checked VCTIP cleanup as check and bench --no-run. Runtime commands cannot use compiler cleanup.
historical_evidence: macOS protocols, absolute limits and failed captures remain unchanged. Windows PE sizes and native timing limits do not certify Mach-O sizes or macOS performance.
